text: Residents of the Oakwood Village neighbourhood contacted my office requesting that we rescind alternate side permit parking along Robina Avenue and affix it to the east side. My office then conducted a poll to ensure that there was community consensus for the proposed switch. With the majority of responses to the poll having returned positive; I am moving a recommendation to enact the following amendment.

The Toronto East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 1st and 3rd Wednesday of each month, April 1 to November 30, inclusive on the east side of Robina Avenue, between a point 54.9 metres north of St. Clair Avenue West and Earlsdale Avenue. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 1st and 3rd Wednesday of each month, April 1 to November 30, inclusive on the east side of Robina Avenue, between a point 79.3 metres north of St. Clair Avenue West and Earlsdale Avenue. 3. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect anytime, except the 1st Wednesday and 3rd Wednesday of each month, April 1 to November 30, inclusive on the west side of Robina Avenue, between a point 54.9 metres north of St. Clair Avenue West and Earlsdale Avenue. 4. Authorized a "No Parking" prohibition to be in effect at all times, on the west side…
